title: La mia storia con te
overview: Sofia Leone, a famous Italian actress, arrives at Fiabilandia to shoot a new TV series alongside her manager Diego, her assistant Mary, and producer Ugo. On set, she meets Adrian, a charming zoo keeper at the park, and an immediate attraction sparks between them. However, their romance is thwarted by Diego, who has invested in the series and blackmails Sofia, threatening to ruin the career of her co-star and ex-flirt, Francesco. Meanwhile, Mary is clumsily courted by Marco, a park employee.  Once Sofia uncovers Diego's schemes, she confronts him with the help of Mary and American producer Barbara Brocchi, regaining control of her life. Yet, her bond with Adrian hits a crisis due to their incompatible worlds: she is bound for Hollywood, while he belongs to Fiabilandia. After a painful goodbye, Adrian realizes he cannot lose her and chases her to the station, but a misunderstanding separates them again. Will two different worlds find a way to coexist?
